resources.string: Blocks games when play time runs out

This service lets Lunio see the name of the app that just opened on screen, and nothing else. When a game chosen by the parent is opened and no play time remains, the phone returns to the home screen and a card explains why.\n\nLunio does not read screen content, text, passwords or messages. The parent can turn this service off at any time from this screen, and the app keeps working without it.
